title: Each new number clones every existing subset, so the list doubles
caption: Cells are subsets of nums = [1, 5, 3] (∅ = the empty subset, "1,5" = [1, 5]). The window marks the copies the current number created.

frames.text: Start with one subset: the empty one.
Add 1: clone the 1 existing subset and append 1 to the copy.
Add 5: clone both subsets and append 5 to each copy. That's 4 subsets.
Add 3: the old level (4 subsets) plus a copy of each with 3. That's 2³ = 8 subsets, all of them.
